title: Ischemic stroke, discharged to inpatient rehab (IRF), summary + case management, no nursing instructions

rationale.pac_list: Case management note documents that a list of Medicare-certified providers of the referred level of care was given to the patient and family.
rationale.pac_choice: Case management note documents freedom of choice and that the patient's selected provider was used.
rationale.pac_quality_data: Case management note documents that Care Compare quality ratings were reviewed with the patient and family.
rationale.meds_consistent: No nursing instructions were provided, so the cross-document medication comparison does not apply.
rationale.pending_results: Hemoglobin A1c is listed as pending and the stroke team is named to forward it.
rationale.followup: Stroke and cardiology visits have named clinicians and dates; PCP visit has a named clinician and a timeframe (within 1 week of rehab discharge).
